## Type
- [ ] Release notes / changelog
- [ ] Privacy policy or terms (legal text)

## Checklist
- [ ] Links work on the published site (GitHub Pages)
- [ ] If legal text changed: effective date bumped and a record added from `templates/privacy-policy-change-template.md`
- [ ] If a release: `CHANGELOG.md`, `release-notes/index.md` and `app-store/listing.md` "What's New" all updated
- [ ] No personal information in examples or screenshots
